# Evidence Docs

## Autogenerated Components and Data Sources Docs

The following directories are autogenerated by scripts in the `scripts/docs`:

- `components` - All user components
- `data-sources` - All data sources

Do not edit these files manually! Instead run the docs generation scripts:

```
npm run docs:generate-components
npm run docs:generate-connectors
```

## Development

Install the [Mintlify CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/mint) to preview the documentation changes locally. To install, use the following command

```
npm i -g mint
```

Run the following command at the root of your documentation (where docs.json is)

```
mint dev
```
